source: Toprank Review Academy (TRA) Nursing Module – Complete Handout

questions.subject: NP III
questions.stem: Bleeding a few hours after surgery when BP returns to normal and dislodges clots is:
questions.rationale: Primary: during surgery; intermediary: first hours; secondary: later from slipped suture or erosion.
questions.source: TRA Nursing Module, Classification of Hemorrhage (PDF p. 495)
questions.quote: Intermediary Hemorrhage occurs during the few hours after surgery

questions.subject: NP III
questions.stem: Bright red blood spurting with each heartbeat indicates:
questions.rationale: Arterial blood is bright red and spurts; venous is dark and flows.
questions.source: TRA Nursing Module, Classification of Hemorrhage (PDF p. 495)
questions.quote: Blood is bright red and appears in spurts with each heartbeat.

questions.subject: NP III
questions.stem: What is the primary intervention for postoperative hypovolemic shock?
questions.rationale: Replace volume, give oxygen, keep warm, monitor closely.
questions.source: TRA Nursing Module, Postop Shock (PDF p. 495)
questions.quote: Primary intervention for hypovolemic shock is volume replacement

questions.subject: NP III
questions.stem: When should the nurse intervene for postoperative nausea?
questions.rationale: Treat nausea early to prevent vomiting.
questions.source: TRA Nursing Module, Nausea and Vomiting (PDF p. 495)
questions.quote: Intervene immediately in the patient’s first report of nausea

questions.subject: NP III
questions.stem: Decreased breath sounds and crackles at the base on day 1 after abdominal surgery suggest:
questions.rationale: Atelectasis results from shallow breathing; turn, deep breathe, use incentive spirometer.
questions.source: TRA Nursing Module, Respiratory Complications (PDF p. 496)
questions.quote: Atelectasis – alveolar collapse; incomplete expansion of lung

questions.subject: NP III
questions.stem: Coughing is contraindicated after which surgery?
questions.rationale: Coughing raises ICP and IOP; also avoided in plastic surgery.
questions.source: TRA Nursing Module, Respiratory Complications (PDF p. 496)
questions.quote: Coughing is contraindicated in patients who have head injuries or who have undergone intracranial surgery, eye surgery

questions.subject: NP III
questions.stem: Before the first postop ambulation, the nurse should first:
questions.rationale: Progress gradually: HOB up, sit, dangle, stand with support.
questions.source: TRA Nursing Module, Ambulation (PDF p. 496)
questions.quote: turned so that both legs are hanging over the edge of the bed

questions.subject: NP III
questions.stem: Which action helps prevent postoperative DVT?
questions.rationale: Hydrate, exercise legs, ambulate early; avoid calf massage and knee gatch.
questions.source: TRA Nursing Module, Preventing DVT (PDF p. 496)
questions.quote: Encourage leg exercises and ambulate patient as soon as permitted

questions.subject: NP III
questions.stem: Signs of a surgical wound infection include:
questions.rationale: Infection: redness, swelling, warmth, pus, odor, fever.
questions.source: TRA Nursing Module, Wound Infection (PDF p. 497)
questions.quote: Pus or other discharge in the wound

questions.subject: NP I
questions.stem: Under RA 9173, a foreign nurse may be licensed without examination through:
questions.rationale: Section 20: registration by reciprocity if requirements are substantially the same.
questions.source: TRA Nursing Module, Registration (PDF p. 498)
questions.quote: SEC. 20. Registration by Reciprocity.

questions.subject: NP I
questions.stem: A special/temporary permit under RA 9173 may be given to a foreign nurse who is:
questions.rationale: Permits cover specialists, medical missions (free), and exchange professors.
questions.source: TRA Nursing Module, Special Permit (PDF p. 498)
questions.quote: Licensed nurses from foreign countries/ states on medical mission whose services shall be free

questions.subject: NP I
questions.stem: Which law is the Continuing Professional Development Act?
questions.rationale: RA 10912 (2016) is the CPD Act; RA 9173 is the Nursing Act; RA 8981 is the PRC Modernization Act.
questions.source: TRA Nursing Module, CPD (PDF p. 498)
questions.quote: According to RA 10912 (Continuing Professional Development Act of 2016)

questions.subject: NP I
questions.stem: 'The right thing to do is the good thing to do' reflects which ethical approach?
questions.rationale: Teleology focuses on outcomes; deontology on duty; virtue ethics on character.
questions.source: TRA Nursing Module, Nursing Ethics (PDF p. 499)
questions.quote: The right thing to do is the good thing to do

questions.subject: NP I
questions.stem: Not revealing confidential information that would harm a patient's reputation illustrates:
questions.rationale: Non-maleficence: do no harm.
questions.source: TRA Nursing Module, Biomedical Ethics (PDF p. 499)
questions.quote: Not harming a person's reputation by revealing confidential information

questions.subject: NP I
questions.stem: A nurse keeps her promise to return in 15 minutes. This shows:
questions.rationale: Fidelity is keeping promises and loyalty.
questions.source: TRA Nursing Module, Biomedical Ethics (PDF p. 499)
questions.quote: Keeping one's promises; loyalty

questions.subject: NP I
questions.stem: Allowing a dying patient's relative to visit outside visiting hours applies the principle of:
questions.rationale: Epikia is a reasonable exception to the general rule.
questions.source: TRA Nursing Module, Principle of Epikia (PDF p. 499)
questions.quote: Exception to the general rule

questions.subject: NP I
questions.stem: In the principle of double effect, which condition is required?
questions.rationale: Action is good, good intended, bad only allowed, good not from evil, good greater than bad.
questions.source: TRA Nursing Module, Two-fold Effect (PDF p. 500)
questions.quote: Good effect must be greater than the bad effect

questions.subject: NP I
questions.stem: Revocation or suspension of a nursing license is what type of case?
questions.rationale: License actions are administrative; appeals go to the PRC.
questions.source: TRA Nursing Module, Legal Aspects (PDF p. 500)
questions.quote: License revocation or suspension is an administrative case.

questions.subject: NP I
questions.stem: Where does a nurse file a case for illegal dismissal?
questions.rationale: Illegal dismissal cases are filed with DOLE; no lawyer needed.
questions.source: TRA Nursing Module, Illegal Dismissal (PDF p. 501)
questions.quote: Department of Labor and Employment

questions.subject: NP I
questions.stem: A sponge is left inside a patient after surgery. Which doctrine applies?
questions.rationale: 'The thing speaks for itself': injury would not occur without negligence.
questions.source: TRA Nursing Module, Res Ipsa Loquitor (PDF p. 501)
questions.quote: The thing speaks for itself

questions.subject: NP I
questions.stem: The hospital shares liability for a staff nurse's negligence under:
questions.rationale: 'Let the master answer': employer shares liability with employee.
questions.source: TRA Nursing Module, Respondeat Superior (PDF p. 501)
questions.quote: Let the master answer for the acts of the subordinate

questions.subject: NP I
questions.stem: An unconscious accident victim needs emergency surgery and no relative is present. Consent is:
questions.rationale: In emergencies consent is implied, since delay may cause greater harm.
questions.source: TRA Nursing Module, Who Must Consent (PDF p. 502)
questions.quote: Implied consent

questions.subject: NP I
questions.stem: Who gives consent for surgery of a married 17-year-old?
questions.rationale: A married or emancipated minor may consent without parents.
questions.source: TRA Nursing Module, Who Must Consent (PDF p. 502)
questions.quote: If the minor is married or otherwise emancipated, parental consent is not needed

questions.subject: NP IV
questions.stem: 'If it was not charted, it was not done' emphasizes that:
options: Notes can be added later freely
questions.rationale: Records are legal protection; notes should be full, accurate, legible, prompt.
questions.source: TRA Nursing Module, Medical Records (PDF p. 502)
questions.quote: If it was not charted, it was not observed or done.
